ke.isaacted.about

An engineer who cares what happens after release.

I've built apps for thousands of daily riders and drivers, merchants taking card payments, farmers in rural Ethiopia with no connectivity, and security guards on night patrols. Very different users, same standard: the app has to be fast, clear and dependable on whatever phone and network they have.

Day to day that means clean MVVM and Clean Architecture in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose UIs that follow platform guidelines, and REST and WebSocket integrations that handle offline states and errors properly. When one codebase for iOS and Android is the right call, I build in Flutter and take it through both store reviews. I also co-founded Chekit, where I run the whole mobile side myself.

Ride-hailing & mobility Logistics E-commerce marketplaces Payments & POS AgTech & public sector Real estate Security operations

ke.isaacted.process

From design handoff to production, step by step.

  1. 01 · Design handoff

    Build screens that match the spec

    I turn design files into Jetpack Compose or Flutter screens that follow Material and Apple guidelines, with responsive layouts that work on small Android phones and large iPhones alike.

    Jetpack ComposeFlutter widgetsMaterial Design
  2. 02 · Integration

    Connect to the backend properly

    REST APIs through Retrofit and OkHttp, WebSockets for live trip and order updates, and Firebase where real-time sync matters. Typed models, clear loading and error states, no silent failures.

    RetrofitOkHttpWebSocketsCoroutines & Flow
  3. 03 · Edge cases

    Plan for bad networks from day one

    Local caching with Room, retry queues and offline-first flows. E-Voucher had to work in rural Ethiopia with no signal, and every app I build gets the same treatment.

    RoomOffline-firstRepository pattern
  4. 04 · Quality

    Test it, then review it with the team

    MVVM, MVI and Clean Architecture keep business logic testable. JUnit, Mockito and Espresso cover it, and every change goes through code review. I give direct feedback and take it well.

    JUnitMockitoEspressoGitHub Actions
  5. 05 · Release

    Release to Google Play and the App Store

    Versioned builds, release notes and staged rollouts, from native Android on Google Play to Flutter builds through App Store review, as with the RoadRims driver app.

    Play ConsoleApp Store ConnectVersioning
  6. 06 · Production

    Keep watching after release

    I monitor crash reports and performance for the features I own and fix issues before users report them. At Little, that work cut load time by 8%.

    FirebaseCrash reportingPerformance
